name: Portainer CE
description: Web interface to manage Docker containers, images, volumes, networks and Compose stacks.

inputs.label: Administrator password (user admin)
inputs.help: Created right after the first start through Portainer's initial-administrator API, so setup cannot time out or be claimed by someone else.

privileges.explain: Portainer mounts the Docker socket. Anyone who can sign in to Portainer controls every container on this PC and, through Docker, the PC itself.

security: Portainer controls every container on this PC. The administrator is created immediately after the first start (password in credentials.txt), so the 5-minute setup window cannot be used by someone else.
Never publish it without Cloudflare Access in front of its own login.

notes: Controls Docker: keep it local; ForwardAuth may be added in front of its own sign-in.

limitations: Needs the Docker socket (full control of Docker on this PC).
Uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate on its local port.

update.notes: LTS channel (2.45.2 at the time of curation).

exposure.warning: Portainer controls Docker on this PC: publish it only behind Cloudflare Access.

choiceGroup.note: Alternative to Arcane for people who prefer Portainer's workflows. Optional; installing both is rarely useful.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, its web interface, network isolation, stack on disk, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
